summary.text: A Nupe town on the banks of the Niger in Kwara State. Its people are mainly Nupe farmers.

history.text: Grew in importance when the Edegi ruling house moved from Gbara and Bida to found the Pategi Emirate, after the British conquest of Bida.

livelihoods.text: Farming (cassava, millet, rice, guinea corn, melon), fishing on the Niger, and trade.
